book.name: JUAN
book.title: Juan' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Jesús ya' chachilla' mityaDiosba kuinda kemi.
Jesús tsandi depa' dya', kai'sha ke'laaditu entsandimi: Apa, yumaa juntsa tinbu jave. Ñu' Nanu tsamantsaa katakaade, tsenmala ñu' Na bain ñunu ura' katakaanutsu.
Ñaa ñu' Nanu naaju chachillanuba demandanguenuu tireve, tsenmala yaa kumuinchi ñu yanu dekuñu chachillanu naa-uwanuba Diosba ura' chumu detirenutsu.
Naa-uwanuba Diosba ura' chunu jumiya, ñuren ura Dios main juunu ura' keemijanaa juve, naa ñu engu eekishu juntsa Jesucristonu bain.
Ñu tyeenguenu mandangueñuba juntsanguetu iya entsa tusha ñunu tsamantsaa katakaayu.
Tsenñu' mitya Apa, umaa kaspele naa entsa tuba jutyunu uranun iya ñuba parejuren tsamantsaa katawantsumuwa deewasu juntsa manen ñu' ajuunuren mangusa tenve.
Entsa tusha chumu chachillanu, ñu dete'laake' inu dekuñu jumulanuya, iya dekeemijakaakiyu ñu muñu bain. Ñu' chachi deenun, ñu yalanu inu dekuñu, yala ñu' kuindanu dekeranguive.
Yala challaa mideeve ñu kumuinchi tiba inu dekuñu judeeshu juntsaa naa ñunu tene defale' jamuñu bain.
Ñu inu demijakaañu kuinda iya yalanu kuinda keñu dekeranguive. Tsa' mitya de-aseetanguive, naa iya ñunaa fale' jañu bain, tsenmin uwain ñaa inu eeñu bain.
Iya yala' mityandiyu ñunu pa' tsandintsumi; ne ujcha lan chumu chachilla' mitya tsandibandindyuyu. Ñu inu dekuñu chachilla' mityandiyu tsandintsumi, ñu' chachi deeñu' mitya.
Kumuinchi inchi judeeshu juntsala ñuchi deeve, tsenmala naa ñuchi judeeshu juntsala bain inchi deeve. Tsa' mitya yala' mityaa iya tsamantsaa katawakutintsuyu.

Entsa ajkeshaya iya entsa tusha tsanan jutyuyu, tsaaren yalaa chaiba entsa tushan chunu detsuve, i ñu' junga maanmala. Tsa' mitya, urandene kemu main juu Apa, ñuya tsamantsaa ju' mitya, ñu' tsamantsaa jumu inu kuwakishu juntsachi yalanu washkide, yai bain lala tsaa shajara' jityu' ma bulu juu tsananudetsu.

Iya entsa tusha yaiba bulu chungamaya, inu ñu' tsamantsaa jumu kuwakishu juntsachi yalanu washke' ti puinuu dejuñu bain livee ken chuchudiyu. Tsenñu naa maliba piyaindetyuve, matyu main maali tsainuu jutu, Diosa' Kiikanu naatiñu bain tsaa puinuu juñu' mityaa, mainyaa tsai' pive.
Umaa ñu' junga maantsuyu, tsejtu entsa patintsaashu juntsa, kayu entsa tusha chumujchin tsandintsumiya, yai bain iya naa-i sundyañuba tsai desundya' iba tsamantsa desundyasa tenñundiyu.
Yalanu ñu' kuinda demijakaakiyu, tsenñu ujcha lan chumu chachilla yalanu mika detyutyave, yala tsaa chachi dejutyuñu, iya bain naaju' yala tsaa chachi jutyaashu juntsa deeñu.
Entsa ne chachilla' kejtsapala, yalanu chutyungue kalaade titundindyuyu, yalanu Dyabulu firu' kenu kiñuba tsanguikaatyude titundiyu.
Yalaa entsa tusha tiba naa naaken chumu deeñuba tsanguemu dejutyuve, naa i bain tsanguemu jutyuyu.
Ñuchin juu chachi detirekide, ñu naajuñu bain keemijakara kuindachi; ñu' palaaya tsanguikaamuve.
Ñu inu entsa tusha naake eeñu bain, i bain yalanu entsa tusha juntsangue eeyu.
Iya yalanu ura' kendenganchin iya maalin ñu' taawasha kemu chachi tiyakutintsuyu, tsenmala yai bain ura uwain tsaren junudetsu.
Ne entsala' mityan juu ñunu pa' tsandindyuyu; bene kayu veela bain, yala kuinda dekiñu inu keranguenu judeeshu juntsala' mitya bain tsaren tindundiyu.

Kumuinchi yalanu ma bulu juuñuu tene detirekisa tenve. Apa, lala naadejaaka ñu iba junmala, i bain ñuba juuwashu, naa yai bain tsa deju' laaba ma bulu judeesa. Tsenmalaa umaa naaju chachilla bain uwain ñaa inu engu eemuwaave tyanudetsu.
Ñu inu naake ura' katakaañu bain, i bain yalanu tsaren katakaayu, tsenmalaa yai bain lala naadejuñu bain, juntsa deju' main juunudetsu,

tsaju' iya yaiba junmala, ñuya iba juve. Tsaashu juntsaa yala main jui narai tiyanu detsuve. Tsenmalaa naaju chachilla bain naa ñaa inu engu eemuñu bain mijanu detsuve, tsenmin ñu inu naa-i estyamu' bain, naa yalanu bain tsai estyamuñu bain mijanu detsuve.

Apa, ñu inu kuwakisu juntsa chachillanuya, naa iya nuka miji' puñu bain, yai bain jungaren iba bulu depusa tenve. Tsejtaa ñu inu estyanchin, naa entsa tuba jutyunu tinbunun, mika ura' katakaamuwaañu tyee juñu bain yala entsangue katanudetsu.
Naake ura' kemu ju'ba tsanguemu Apa, ujcha lan chumu chachillaya ñunu keemijaindetyuve, tsaanuren iya ñunu kerayu, naa enu iba bulu pumu chachilla bain mideeve ñaa inu engu eemuñu bain.
Ñu muñu bain yalanu dekeemijakaakiyu, tsejturen kayu keemijakares jintsunu tsuyu, tsenmalaa ñu inu naa-i estyamuñu bain yaitala bain tsaren dejunmala, i bain yaiba ma bulu juu chunu tsuyu, timi.
